Have a good game!

notes.title: We have to postpone the release (through no fault of our own)
notes.content:
Hello, we have to postpone the release of the game. Unfortunately, the game is on steam verification.

At the moment, the game is fully completed and ready for release, but we are not given the opportunity to release it.
We'll release the game as soon as we're given the opportunity

We really hope for your understanding and thank you for waiting!
